Import matrices per population and per year 
Import matrices per population 
Will be used to define the initial distribution for each population


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
library(splines)
library(tidyverse)
library(spaMM)
spaMM.options(separation_max=70)
library(popbio)
annees <- 1:26
populations <- c("Po","Au","Pe","E1","E2","Cr")

#Load the matrices 
load("Aumatrices.Rdata"); MAu <- matrices[-1] #remove year=1995
load("E1matrices.Rdata"); ME1 <- matrices[-1]
load("E2matrices.Rdata"); ME2 <- matrices[-1]
load("Pomatrices.Rdata"); MPo <- matrices[-1]
load("Pematrices.Rdata"); MPe <- matrices[-1]
load("Crmatrices.Rdata"); MCr <- matrices[-1]


 #Asymptotic value per populations
for (p in 1:length(populations)) {
    Pop <- populations[p]
  lambdaA <- NULL
  if (Pop=="E2") {matrices <- ME2}
  if (Pop=="E1") {matrices <- ME1}
  if (Pop=="Au") {matrices <- MAu}
  if (Pop=="Po") {matrices <- MPo}
  if (Pop=="Pe") {matrices <- MPe}
  if (Pop=="Cr") {matrices <- MCr}

  for (year in annees)
 {lambdaA[year] <- lambda(matrices[[year]])}

 cat("Population=",Pop,"Mean LambdaA=", mean(lambdaA),
        "Min=", min(lambdaA),"Max=", max(lambdaA), "\n")

}



#Stochastic growth rate
#Using the global matrice to define the initial distribution
load("matrice_globale.Rdata")
lambdaS <- NULL
lambdaSPo <- NULL
lambdaSAu <- NULL
lambdaSPe <- NULL
lambdaSE1 <- NULL
lambdaSE2 <- NULL
lambdaSCr <- NULL

for (p in 1:length(populations)) {
  # Initialisation
  Pop <- populations[p]
  
  if (Pop=="E2") {matrices <- ME2}
  if (Pop=="E1") {matrices <- ME1}
  if (Pop=="Au") {matrices <- MAu}
  if (Pop=="Po") {matrices <- MPo}
  if (Pop=="Pe") {matrices <- MPe}
  if (Pop=="Cr") {matrices <- MCr}

    #1000 iterations
    for (iter in 1:1000) {
      N0 <- eigen.analysis(matrice_globale)$stable.stage
         # Iteration over 100 years
           time <- 1
             repeat
               {
               yr <- sample(annees,1)
               Nt <-matrices[[yr]] %*% N0 
               lambdaS[time] <- log(sum(Nt))
               N0 <- Nt/sum(Nt)
               time <- time + 1
               if (sum(Nt)==0 || time >100) break
             }
      
         lambdaS[is.infinite(lambdaS)] <- 1e-16
           
  if (Pop=="E2") {lambdaSE2[iter] <- exp(mean(lambdaS, na.rm=T))}
  if (Pop=="E1") {lambdaSE1[iter] <- exp(mean(lambdaS, na.rm=T))}
  if (Pop=="Au") {lambdaSAu[iter] <- exp(mean(lambdaS, na.rm=T))}
  if (Pop=="Po") {lambdaSPo[iter] <- exp(mean(lambdaS, na.rm=T))}
  if (Pop=="Pe") {lambdaSPe[iter] <- exp(mean(lambdaS, na.rm=T))}
  if (Pop=="Cr") {lambdaSCr[iter] <- exp(mean(lambdaS, na.rm=T))}                              } #end of iterations
    
} #end of populations


mean(lambdaSE2);mean(lambdaSE2)-1.96*sd(lambdaSE2);mean(lambdaSE2)+1.96*sd(lambdaSE2);
mean(lambdaSE1);mean(lambdaSE1)-1.96*sd(lambdaSE1);mean(lambdaSE1)+1.96*sd(lambdaSE1);
mean(lambdaSAu);mean(lambdaSAu)-1.96*sd(lambdaSAu);mean(lambdaSAu)+1.96*sd(lambdaSAu);
mean(lambdaSPo);mean(lambdaSPo)-1.96*sd(lambdaSPo);mean(lambdaSPo)+1.96*sd(lambdaSPo);
mean(lambdaSPe);mean(lambdaSPe)-1.96*sd(lambdaSPe);mean(lambdaSPe)+1.96*sd(lambdaSPe);
mean(lambdaSCr);mean(lambdaSCr)-1.96*sd(lambdaSCr);mean(lambdaSCr)+1.96*sd(lambdaSCr)
 
```
